# Normalization by internal standards (IS)

## Internal standards (ISs) 

```{r}
#| child: !expr file.path(chapters_dir, "process-internal-stds.qmd")
```

## Normalization by ISs

The dataset is normalized using the provided ISs. The user can opt to choose between 3 normalization methods:

- "Closest RT" method, whereby the peak area intensity of each feature/chemical is corrected with that of the closest IS in RT. Target classes of compounds can be specified.
- "LOESS" method, whereby the peak area intensity of each feature/chemical is corrected by a LOESS model curve built using all the IS spanning across the entire chromatographic RT.
- "Multivariate (PCA)" method, whereby the peak area intensity of each feature/chemical is divided by a per-sample factor from the first principal component of the unit-variance scaled IS peak areas (Surowiec et al. 2017, Metabolomics 13:114).

```{r}
#| purl: true
# Find the range of RT values
all_rts <- util$retention_time(pre_norm_se)
overall_rt_range <- range(all_rts)
targetted_rt_range <- range(all_rts[util$is_targeted_feature(pre_norm_se)])
rt <- range(all_rts[util$is_internal_std(pre_norm_se)])
```

The retention time (RT) range of the dataset is between `r overall_rt_range[1]` and `r overall_rt_range[2]` min.
The RT range of the targeted chemicals to be quantified is from `r targetted_rt_range[1]` to `r targetted_rt_range[2]` min.
The RT range of the internal standards is from `r range(rt)[1]` to `r range(rt)[2]` min.

```{r}
#| purl: true
norm_se <- to_report[["normalized"]]
```

```{r}
#| label: blank-filtering
if (to_report$blank_filter) {
  cat("

### Blank filtering

Features are filtered based on the blank samples after normalization and before blank subtraction.
A feature is kept if:
    
*   The maximum peak area in the samples is greater than",
    to_report$blank_filter_factor, "times the average peak area in the blanks, OR
*   The average peak area in the samples is greater than", 
    to_report$blank_filter_factor, "times the average peak area in the blanks.
\n\n")

  se_before_blank_filter <- to_report[["normalized"]]
  se_after_blank_filter <- to_report[["after blank filtering"]]
  before_n <- nrow(se_before_blank_filter)
  after_n <- sum(SumExp::row_df(se_after_blank_filter)[["blank_filtered"]])
  removed_n <- before_n - after_n

  cat("
Number of features filtered based on blank:

*   Number of features before filtering:", before_n, "
*   Number of features removed:", removed_n, "
*   Number of features remaining:", after_n, "\n")
}
```

### Blank subtraction

After data normalization, peak areas are blank corrected by subtracting the corresponding feature average peak area detected in the blanks (negative values set to zero).
Blank subtraction is applied to all samples in the dataset except for the calibration standards per batch.

### Per-batch processing summary

Which blank average was subtracted from each batch and which calibration curve was used (`r params$norm_method`).
A batch without blank samples is subtracted by the average of all blank samples (of all batches).
A batch is calibrated by its own calibration curve when it has enough calibration curve replicates; otherwise by the global calibration curve of all batches.

```{r}
#| label: per-batch-processing-summary
#| results: 'asis'
norm_cd <- SumExp::col_df(to_report[["normalized"]])   # After outlier removal, incl. blanks
batch_ids_all <- names(to_report[["normalized - blank"]])
n_blank <- vapply(batch_ids_all, function(b) {
  sum(as.character(norm_cd$batch_id) == b & norm_cd$.ctrl_cat == "Blank")
}, integer(1))
no_blank <- to_report[["batches without blank"]]
summary_df <- data.frame(
  Batch = batch_ids_all,
  `Blank samples` = n_blank,
  `Blank subtracted` = ifelse(batch_ids_all %in% no_blank, "Average of all batches", "Batch"),
  check.names = FALSE
)
cal_per_batch <- to_report[["calibration per batch"]]
if (IS_TARGET_MODE && !is.null(cal_per_batch)) {
  d <- cal_per_batch[cal_per_batch$mat_id == MAT_ID_BLANK_SUBT, ]
  i <- match(summary_df$Batch, as.character(d$batch_id))
  summary_df$Calibration <- as.character(d$calibration)[i]
  summary_df$Note <- dplyr::coalesce(as.character(d$note)[i], "")
}
summary_df |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Blank subtraction and calibration per batch", row.names = FALSE) |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE) |>
  print()
```

```{r}
#| label: qc-rsd-filtering
#| results: 'asis'
rf <- to_report[["qc rsd filter"]]
if (isTRUE(rf$enabled)) {
  cat("\n\n### QC RSD% filtering\n\n")
  limits <- c(
    if (!is.na(rf$max_targeted)) paste0("targeted features with a QC RSD% above ", rf$max_targeted, "%"),
    if (!is.na(rf$max_nontargeted)) paste0("non-targeted features with a QC RSD% above ", rf$max_nontargeted, "%")
  )
  cat("After normalization and blank subtraction, the RSD% of each feature among the QC replicates",
      "was computed (per QC class; the median over the classes), and",
      paste(limits, collapse = " and "), "were removed, per normalization method.",
      "Removed targeted compounds are not calibrated.\n\n")
  if (isTRUE(rf$skipped)) {
    cat("**The QC RSD% filter was requested but skipped.**", rf$skip_reason, "\n\n")
  } else {
    rem <- to_report[["removed features"]]
    rem_rsd <- rem[rem$reason == "QC RSD%", ]
    mat_ids <- to_report[["matrix ids to blk subt"]]
    data.frame(
      `Normalization` = mat_ids,
      `Targeted removed` = vapply(mat_ids, \(m) sum(rem_rsd$mat_id == m & rem_rsd$targeted), integer(1)),
      `Non-targeted removed` = vapply(mat_ids, \(m) sum(rem_rsd$mat_id == m & !rem_rsd$targeted), integer(1)),
      check.names = FALSE
    ) |>
      knitr::kable(caption = "Features removed by the QC RSD% filter", row.names = FALSE) |>
      kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE) |>
      print()
    tgt <- rem_rsd[rem_rsd$mat_id == params$norm_method & rem_rsd$targeted, ]
    if (nrow(tgt) > 0) {
      data.frame(Compound = tgt$feature_name, `QC RSD%` = round(tgt$qc_rsd, 1), check.names = FALSE) |>
        dplyr::arrange(Compound) |>
        knitr::kable(caption = paste0("Targeted compounds removed by the QC RSD% filter (",
                                      params$norm_method, ")"), row.names = FALSE) |>
        kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE) |>
        kableExtra::scroll_box(height = "300px") |>
        print()
    }
  }
}
```
